name: Bed, boxspring 150 × 200, with headboard

clearance.note: Room to get in and make the bed

notes: Generic boxspring bed, not a specific product: for a 150 × 200 cm mattress, exactly 150 cm wide overall, with an upholstered headboard. Built as bed-boxspring-160x200: six low feet, a box spring, a pocket-spring mattress and a topper, 62 cm to the top (feet 7, box spring 28, mattress 21, topper 6 cm). The headboard is 116 cm high (XXXLutz BOXXX: 116 cm, IKEA DUNVIK: 120 cm) and 10 cm deep, with 6 padded vertical channels; it has its own material slot. The item is 212 cm long: 200 + the headboard's 10 + 2 cm left free behind it, so wall snap puts the headboard flush against the back panel of the wardrobe walls' bed alcove (against a plain wall it stands 2 cm off). In the alcove (177 cm wide) it leaves 13.5 cm on each side, and the headboard stays below the sconces of wardrobe-wall-bed-alcove-r5 and -low (135–150 cm); in the original version the sconce shades (103–118 cm) hang beside its outer channels, 10–20 cm in front of it. The mattress is a surface for the bedding (duvet-200x210, pillow-65x65, bedspread-quilted-240x260, made for 160 cm beds: on this one the duvet is 7.5 cm wider than the mattress on each side).
